descriptionChirho: The abstract noun denoting illicit sexual conduct, encompassing fornication, adultery, and all forms of sexual immorality outside the covenant of marriage. Uniformly rendered across languages: Spanish 'fornicacion', Hindi 'vyabhichaar' (व्यभिचार), Arabic 'zina' (الزِّنا), Korean 'eumhaeng' (음행), Swahili 'uasherati/uzinzi'. The three original clusters represent only singular case forms (nominative, dative, accusative, genitive) and plural forms of the same single concept, with no semantic distinction between them.
